claim: Once HSP-029 has cut issuance to 1.6%, a doubling of Intents volume would make supply shrink
test: breakeven_volume_multiple for scenario hsp029_end_state at the measured capture rate (fct_deflation_scenarios)
why_this_threshold: A doubling is the bar the claim names

claim: NEAR keeps a rising share of the fees charged on Intents
test: capture_rate in the last complete month minus capture_rate six months before it (fct_intents_unit_economics_monthly)
why_this_threshold: Any rise over half a year counts

claim: NEAR kept at least a fifth of Intents fees in each of the last three complete months
test: The lowest capture_rate of the last three complete months (fct_intents_unit_economics_monthly)
why_this_threshold: The bar the Deflation Clock's thesis named as what would change its author's mind

claim: Use of Chain Signatures is growing
test: Mean daily transactions to v1.signer over the newest 30 days over the 30 days ending 180 days earlier, minus 1 (fct_chain_signatures_daily)
why_this_threshold: Any growth over half a year counts

claim: Other cross-chain swap protocols are as large as NEAR Intents and can take its flow
test: Not testable: the warehouse holds no series for other cross-chain swap protocols yet

claim: NEAR's market cap per dollar of TVL is at least twice the median peer's
test: NEAR's market_cap_usd over tvl_usd, over the median of the six peers', on the newest day (fct_peer_daily)
why_this_threshold: Twice the median is a round bar for thin

claim: The Bitwise ETF has taken in more NEAR than the chain issued since the fund's first day
test: cumulative_flow_to_issuance_ratio on the newest trading day (fct_etf_absorption_daily)
why_this_threshold: More than issuance means a ratio of at least one

claim: One distribution partner supplies more than half of 1Click's fees
test: top_1_share of the channel_fees cut in its last complete month (fct_intents_concentration_monthly)
why_this_threshold: More than half is what dependence on one partner means

claim: The NEAR Foundation's liquid NEAR is a large overhang on the float
test: Not testable: the Foundation's last published holding is 305M NEAR on 2024-01-11 (registry/near_supply_readings.csv); nothing newer is public

claim: At least 100 accounts voted on the newest House of Stake proposal that is not a test
test: voters on that proposal (fct_governance_proposals)
why_this_threshold: A hundred is a low bar for a chain with tens of thousands of daily signers

claim: NEAR Intents is where most application fees on NEAR are paid
test: NEAR Intents' share of 30-day application fees on NEAR in the newest fct_protocol_fees_snapshot (measure fees, the chain's own row left out)
why_this_threshold: More than half is what most means

claim: NEAR's revenue from Intents is growing
test: Revenue per day in the last complete month over the month three before it, minus 1 (fct_intents_unit_economics_monthly)
why_this_threshold: Any growth over a quarter counts

claim: The chain issues more than five times what burn and revenue take back
test: 1 over offset_share on the newest settled day (fct_net_dilution_daily)
why_this_threshold: The published remark said about six times; five is the round bar under it

claim: Most Intents volume now settles confidentially
test: 1 minus public volume over all-route volume, over the 30 settled days to the newest (fct_intents_daily)
why_this_threshold: More than half is what most means

claim: NEAR AI has paying users
test: Not testable: NEAR AI publishes no usage or revenue figures, and its one on-chain trace, escrow.ai.near, has a single caller

claim: NEAR's price beat the median peer over 90 days
test: NEAR's 90-day price change minus the median of the six peers' (fct_peer_daily)
why_this_threshold: Beating means a gap above zero

claim: NEAR trades above the median peer on application fees
test: NEAR's multiple on the app_fees basis over the median of the six peers', on the newest settled day (fct_valuation_multiples_daily)
why_this_threshold: Above the median means a ratio over one

claim: NEAR keeps less than half of the fees charged on Intents
test: capture_rate in the last complete month (fct_intents_unit_economics_monthly)
why_this_threshold: Under half means the larger part goes to others

claim: Gas burned and revenue received take back at least a tenth of what the chain issues
test: offset_share on the newest settled day (fct_net_dilution_daily)
why_this_threshold: A tenth is a round bar for material

claim: A month of NEAR's Intents revenue is under 0.1% of a month of reported spot trading in NEAR
test: revenue_usd over reported_spot_volume_usd, both summed over the 30 settled days to the newest (fct_intents_daily, fct_market_daily)
why_this_threshold: A thousandth of trading is too little to move a price by itself

claim: The revenue wallets keep the NEAR they receive: under 5% of it has left
test: NEAR sent out of the three revenue wallets, not counting moves between them, over NEAR they received (fct_wallet_flows_daily, fct_revenue_inflows_daily)
why_this_threshold: Small enough to be operations rather than selling

claim: A few solvers fill most Intents volume
test: Not testable: no public source gives solver counts or shares; the warehouse holds only the distinct callers of intents.near

claim: NEAR's supply is shrinking
test: net_inflation_rate on the newest settled day (fct_net_dilution_daily)
why_this_threshold: Shrinking means at or below zero

claim: The Sweat relayer, which stops when Sweat Wallet ends on 2026-12-30, carries at least a fifth of the transactions left after the batch streams
test: sweat_relayer_txns over txns_ex_batch_streams, both summed over the newest 30 days (fct_usage_quality_daily)
why_this_threshold: A fifth is a round bar for a loss that would show in every usage chart

claim: Transactions without the batch streams are lower than six months ago
test: Mean txns_ex_batch_streams over the newest 30 days over the 30 days ending 180 days earlier, minus 1 (fct_usage_quality_daily)
why_this_threshold: Any fall over half a year counts

claim: The validator set shrank by more than 5% in 60 days
test: Validators in the newest complete epoch over the mean of the complete epochs 55 to 65 days before it, minus 1 (fct_validator_summary)
why_this_threshold: One pool in twenty leaving in two months

claim: Most 1Click volume is one stablecoin swapped for another
test: Share of finished 1Click volume whose two sides are both stablecoins, in the last complete month of the daily run (fct_intents_1click_pair_daily)
why_this_threshold: More than half is what most means

claim: Intents volume was at least $2B in each of the last three complete months
test: The lowest volume_usd of the last three complete months (fct_intents_unit_economics_monthly)
why_this_threshold: The bar the Deflation Clock's thesis named as what would change its author's mind

claim: Zcash is on one side of at least a fifth of 1Click volume
test: Share of finished 1Click volume with ZEC as origin or destination, in the last complete month of the daily run (fct_intents_1click_pair_daily)
why_this_threshold: The published share of ZEC alone was 9% of all volume; a fifth on either side is the bar for dependence
